fields.sql: WITH `p0` (`c0`, `c1`) AS (SELECT `s0`.`rid` AS `c0`, CAST(1 AS SIGNED) AS `c1` FROM `phase66`.`phase66 widths` AS `s0`), `p1` (`c0`, `c1`, `c2`) AS (SELECT `s1`.`c0` AS `c0`, `s1`.`c1` AS `c1`, NTILE() OVER (ORDER BY `s1`.`c0` ASC) AS `c2` FROM `p0` AS `s1`) SELECT `t2`.`c0` AS `record_id`, `t2`.`c2` AS `w` FROM `p1` AS `t2`
